data.why: A yard scene with the pool pit dug into the cut ground in section. A concrete shell goes in, then water, and a pump, pipes and a filter tank run along the face beside the pit. The camera opens close on the hole, shows the soaking, slumping walls and the shell and water going in, then pulls out to follow the water loop through pump and filter, ending on the calm home view with a fence and trees.

ideas.idea: dig a hole in the yard and pour water in, and you think you have a pool
but the water just soaks into the soil and leaks away
within an hour the hole is empty bare mud
the wet walls slump in, since a cubic yard of wet soil weighs about 3,000 pounds
so you pour a concrete floor and walls that hold the water and the soil back
so you fill the shell, about 20,000 gallons that weigh around 83 tons
but still water goes stale, so a pipe from the bottom carries it to a pump
then a filter tank catches the dirt and a second pipe sends the clean water back
this is a swimming pool
the pump, filter and pipes together are the circulation system
the pump pulls water from the bottom, the filter strains out the dirt, and clean water flows back in
a typical pump pushes the pool's whole volume through the filter about once every 8 hours
a clock ticks 8 hours, so every drop goes through the filter about three times a day
but a filter cannot stop living algae, so in the sun the water turns green
then a storm blows leaves and mud in and the water gets murkier
so you add chlorine and the water clears
and the blue is not paint on the pool
water itself absorbs red light and sends blue back, so it looks blue
add a fence, bushes and young trees around the pool
calm clear pool with the water loop running: you have built a swimming pool

chain.shows: water in the bare hole seeps down through the soil and drains away
chain.stakes: the pool never holds water and the walls turn to mud

chain.shows: the clear water turns green in the sun
chain.stakes: swimmers cannot see the bottom of the pool

chain.shows: a storm drops rain and mud lumps into the green water
chain.stakes: the pool turns murky and filthy
